say:2:1530136001:1.text: The Halians might attack Wrathwood Grove, or come steal our prey.
say:2:1530136001:1.source_cn: 当然是呼临人来进攻树怒山谷，或者是到附近抢夺我们的猎物。
say:2:1530136001:1.male: The Halians might attack Wrathwood Grove, or come steal our prey.
say:2:1530136001:1.female: The Halians might attack Wrathwood Grove, or come steal our prey.

say:3:1530136002:1.text: I heard Halia is starving. People dropping dead from hunger. That's why they seized Mirehold—for food.
say:3:1530136002:1.source_cn: 我听说呼临城在闹饥荒，好多人都饿死了，他们为了食物才占...

say:4:1530136003:1.text: Wrathwood Grove is the heart of our homeland. We can't let the Halians take it!
say:4:1530136003:1.source_cn: 树怒山谷是雅库伯尔的中心，绝对不能让呼临人占领！

say:5:1530136004:1.text: Don't worry. We have the Hunting Goddess' protection.
say:5:1530136004:1.source_cn: 不用担心，我们有狩猎神庇护！
